path.description: The corpus to scan; else the first input artifact, else the working dataset.

sample_size.description: Reservoir-sample this many rows for the STATISTICAL tiers (format conformance, profile stats, NER density) — a valid go/no-go estimate that keeps the check O(1) in dataset size (#737). Dedup hashes, the format-detection vote, and the SECRET regex always scan every row. null = run the statistical tiers over the full corpus too.

target_trainers.description: Trainers to report format compatibility for (dataset/format).

expected_format.description: Force a format instead of auto-detecting from the corpus vote.

normalize.description: Collapse whitespace before hashing so rows differing only in spacing count as duplicates (dataset/dedup).

short_threshold.description: Responses shorter than this many chars are flagged short (dataset/profile).

refusal_markers.description: Case-insensitive refusal substrings (default set used if None).

strict.description: Malformed-line handling (#1008): False quarantines bad JSONL lines to a side file and counts them; True fails fast.

engine.description: Full-corpus pass engine: 'python' (one streaming read) | 'duckdb' (row count, dedup distinct-key, every-row secret scan and the reservoir sample as SQL — the format vote then comes from the sample). Fails loudly without the duckdb package.

backend.description: PII backend: 'auto' | 'regex' | 'regexset' | 'presidio' | 'cascade' (regex-in-presidio, ADR-0079) | 'duckdb' (the regex tier; sample density is scanned with the Python regex tier).

text_fields.description: Top-level field(s) holding training text to scan; null = auto free-text leaves (skip token/label lists, #1021 F4).

ner.description: Detect names/locations with spaCy (null = preset value).

model.description: spaCy model powering NER (null = preset value).

n_process.description: CPU workers for the NER pass; 0 = all cores (null = preset).

analyze_chunk.description: Rows fed to the detector at once (null = preset value).

secrets_full_scan.description: Scan every row for leaked secrets (ADR-0080 P1) and merge into the gate's blocking vocabulary even when NER density is sampled.

max_findings.description: Cap the enumerated per-row PII/format `findings` lists (#891).

ner_skip_below_conformant_pct.description: Guard early-exit (ADR-0080 D2): when sampled format conformance is below this, the dataset already FAILs the format gate, so the CPU-heavy NER pass is skipped. Full-corpus secret scanning still runs (leaked keys still block), and only WARN-level sampled PII is skipped — never changes the verdict. 0 = never skip.
